put:

  summary: Update a time-off policy (GET-then-PUT merge)

    the full body, then PUTs the merged result back.
    Source: internal/tools/time_off_policies.go:131 path construction,
    line 165 s.Client.Put().
    Param name discrepancy: official spec uses {id}, ours uses {policyId}.
    Cosmetic only -- same URL segment. Both work on live Clockify.

    Response includes full policy: id, name, timeUnit, archived, allowHalfDay,
    allowNegativeBalance, approve, automaticAccrual, automaticTimeEntryCreation,

    userGroupIds, userIds, workspaceId.

    - {name: workspaceId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: policyId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}

    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              maxLength: 150

              description: Accrual config with amount, period, timeUnit

              type: boolean

              type: object

            everyoneIncludingNew:
              type: boolean
            archived:
              type: boolean
            automaticTimeEntryCreation:
              type: object
  responses:

      description: Updated policy object (full shape)
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id: {type: string}
              name: {type: string}

              archived: {type: boolean}
              allowHalfDay: {type: boolean}
              allowNegativeBalance: {type: boolean}
              approve: {type: object}
              automaticAccrual: {type: object, nullable: true}
              automaticTimeEntryCreation: {type: object}
              balance_rules: {type: object}
              everyoneIncludingNew: {type: boolean}
              negativeBalance: {type: object}
              projectId: {type: string}
              userGroupIds:
                type: array
                items: {type: string}
              userIds:
                type: array
                items: {type: string}
              workspaceId: {type: string}

endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  operationId: updateUserGroup
  summary: Update a user group by ID (full-replacement PUT)
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-060000-put.workspaces.user-groups-official-live-put.json
  x-notes: |
    Live PUT returns 200 with full group object. MCP tool clockify_groups_update
    dispatches to PUT /workspaces/{wId}/user-groups/{groupId}.
    Source: internal/tools/groups_holidays.go:364 path construction,
    line 369 s.Client.Put().
    Required args: group_id and name (both required by MCP tool schema).
    Optional args: user_ids (array -- sent as full replacement list, not append).
    Clockify enforces workspace-scoped name uniqueness: sending the current name
    returns a 400 business error (User group with name X already exists).
    This confirms the path reaches Clockify business logic layer.
    Response shape: id, name, teamManagers (array), userIds (array), workspaceId.
    Meta does not include changedFields (unlike time-off-policies).
    Official spec param name is {id}; ours is {groupId} -- cosmetic alias only.
    No dry_run support in UpdateUserGroupAdmin (only DeleteUserGroupAdmin has dry_run).
  x-truth-iter: iter22
  parameters:
    - {name: workspaceId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
    - {name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required: [name]
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              maxLength: 150
            userIds:
              type: array
              items: {type: string}
              description: Full desired membership list (replacement semantics)
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Updated group object
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id: {type: string}
              name: {type: string}
              teamManagers:
                type: array
                items: {type: object}
              userIds:
                type: array
                items: {type: string}
              workspaceId: {type: string}
    '400':
      description: Name already taken in this workspace
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED. PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/user-groups/{id} confirmed live with HTTP 200. Required body fields: name (required by both Clockify and MCP tool schema). user_ids is optional but when provided replaces the full membership list (not an append). Clockify enforces unique name constraint — sending an existing name returns 400 business error confirming path reaches business logic. Param name discrepancy (id vs groupId) is cosmetic only.
